items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Professor Claiborne William brass band used to come to Napoleonville and play parades.

ctx.x: They lived in Napoleonville too? They did. Can you remember what kind of music was there when you were a boy? The first kind of music you ever heard? either around the home or in any churches or dance halls or any place else? There's parades? Were there any parades?

The first kind of music I heard when I was a boy at home to remember, that was brass band music. Professor Claiborne William brass band. Oh yeah, I've heard of the band from Donaldsonville. Professor Claiborne William brass band used to come to Napoleonville and play parades. Well I was around about eight years old. I used to come there and play parades with you and uh, uh, Donaldsonville is just about 16 miles from the coast. That's old.
Uh, did you hear any uh dance music? Uh, and how, first of all let's get back to the parade though, did the band sort of swing like they do in the street today? No, no, it wasn't nothing like that.
